The key, as he sees it, lies in education and a willingness to adapt, ensuring that we guide the development and implementation of AI with a clear understanding of what human contributions we value and wish to protect. Artificial intelligence, like any powerful tool, presents both considerable benefits and potential threats. The key lies in our application and governance of it.
